steps.name: add-soak-diagnostics
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller; git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "cd630d079a97571384ff595a63d1685c9e6a53c7"; python3 -c "import base64,zlib;exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))"; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/native/BleClimateState.h src/climate/native/BleClimateState.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.h src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp test/test_ble_climate_state/test_main.cpp || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/native/BleClimateState.h src/climate/native/BleClimateState.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.h src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp test/test_ble_climate_state/test_main.cpp; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: focused-soak-diagnostics-gate
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "cd630d079a97571384ff595a63d1685c9e6a53c7"
git diff --check
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R ble_climate_state_tests --output-on-failure
grep -q 'soak uptime_ms=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'heap_internal_min=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'tp_rejected=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'scd_read_errors=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build

verify_steps.name: full-soak-diagnostics-gate-and-publish
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "cd630d079a97571384ff595a63d1685c9e6a53c7"
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build
git diff --check
git add src/climate/native/BleClimateState.h src/climate/native/BleClimateState.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.h src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp test/test_ble_climate_state/test_main.cpp
git commit -m 'Add Stage27C soak diagnostics'
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --short)"
git rev-parse HEAD
